name: Spiral Memoria ~Watashi to Deau Natsu~
source:
Our protagonist Asanaga Miku is just a normal high school girl.  However, she conceals a secret: "amnesia". She holds no memories of her life up to junior high school. Mysterious dreams, overprotective parents, unnatural memory loss... What is the future "Miku" is looking for, even if she doesn't know her past...?

Am I the "me" you love? Or am I the real me?
translation:
我们的主角浅永未来只是一个普通的女高中生。然而，她却隐藏着一个秘密：“失忆症”。她对初中之前的生活没有任何记忆。神秘的梦境、过度保护的父母、不自然的记忆丧失……“Miku”正在寻找的未来是什么，即使她不知道自己的过去……？

我是你爱的“我”吗？还是我就是真正的我？
